question_ru: Добавляет ли TACHYON R4 воспроизводимую полезную функцию временного связывания к реальному референсному DemiHead, превосходит ли простой детерминированный baseline и какова её вычислительная стоимость?

heads.A: Actual DemiHead main tools.keto_reference.summarize_case, no temporal labels
heads.B: Exactly the same unchanged DemiHead plus Simptomat R4 learned softmax sidecar, weights deterministically replayed from pinned source commit, not an original signed fixed model checkpoint
heads.C: Exactly the same DemiHead plus transparently defined hand-coded temporal recurrence rules

pinned_sources.DEMIHEAD: main baseline at PR creation (GitHub Actions checkout, not a production deployment)

predeclared_challenge.origin: New deterministic evaluator cases; NOT imported from Simptomat training generator or patient data
predeclared_challenge.evaluation: Each of 230 inputs passed through actual DemiHead for A, B and C; B/C classify same temporal meta attributes; A abstains from classification because no such output in main.
predeclared_challenge.note: New challenge author knows the algorithm contracts. This is NOT a cryptographically sealed external blind exam; absolute ID/status features directly expose most labels.
predeclared_challenge.sources_of_holdout_independence: Separate authoring and distinct family IDs; still synthetically similar schema from shared task definition.

primary: B minus C paired valid-case accuracy difference in percentage points; zero/negative is NOT a learned gain over rules
B and C invalid-provenance false-accept counts; required 0
Equality of actual DemiHead source-evidence outcomes across A, B, C; required all
A temporal coverage is structural, NOT general intelligence accuracy
secondary: R4 replay CPU train cost separate from per-case overhead
per-arm exploratory median per-case microseconds on one CI runner, not standardized latency
challenge SHA256 and class-wise failure indices, no post-hoc data selection
metrics.minimum_for_engineering_pass: Comparator executes in CI with all three real source heads invoked, zero privacy/temporal provenance false accept and all baseline DemiHead evidence states unchanged
metrics.required_for_scientific_gain: Separate trustworthy hidden external tasks, independent custodian/third-party holdout, prespecified clinically appropriate calibration and measured TACHYON advantage over strong rule baseline, full costs, repeat seeds and confidence intervals.
metrics.statistical_status: Descriptive paired benchmark only; no p-values or new human cognitive hypothesis tests; 230 synthetic cases are not independent patients.
metrics.multiplicity: No clinical inferential hypothesis tested here; future multiple primary endpoints and familywise correction must be preregistered independently.

negative_controls: same content but different event ids => separate episodes
one event id shared by memory reference is not physical recurrence
today's plan for tomorrow is not an observed event
missing IDs and self-contradictory continuation/memory links => abstain

runtime.external_checkout: Pinned public upstream Simptomat repository and commit; no arbitrary branch
